The '''Indu San system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Indu San/Legends|Indu San]]. It was governed by the [[Indu Council]].

At one point, the system was ruled by [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governors]]. However, the Council considered an alliance with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] when [[Shek Barayel]] became chief [[council]]or.
